title: Concepts 101
productJob: A durable reference for tracing one AI request from the reader's goal through product, context, model and optional tools to an output that still needs a human check.
audience: A reader without technical background who needs a connected mental model rather than isolated definitions.
readerQuestion: What happens between asking an AI for something and deciding whether I can use the result?
learnerOutcome: The reader can locate a failure in the system and choose the next safe action: improve the brief, supply a current source, reduce context, check a product capability, verify a claim or limit an action.

causalModel.oneLine: goal + prompt + available context -> product -> model -> optional tools -> output -> human check
causalModel.beforeTask: Training shaped the model before the reader's current request.
causalModel.duringTask: The product assembles context and may let the model use retrieval or other tools.
causalModel.afterOutput: Evidence, authority and human judgment determine whether the result can be used.

sections.title: The system, not one magic box
sections.mechanism: Provider, product, model and tools are separate layers.
sections.distinction: A model is not the whole product.
sections.action: Name the system layer before diagnosing the failure.

sections.title: What reaches the model for this task
sections.readerQuestion: What information can it use right now?
sections.mechanism: The product selects prompt, instructions, conversation, files, retrieved passages and possibly remembered details into bounded context.
sections.distinction: Training data, current context, memory and a live source are not interchangeable.
sections.action: Supply the current source and make the important evidence easy to find.

sections.title: What tools add
sections.readerQuestion: How can it search, inspect or act?
sections.mechanism: A permitted tool can fetch material, calculate, run code or affect another service.
sections.distinction: Retrieval is not grounding; grounding is not verification; a sandbox is not a truth check.
sections.action: Check sources, permissions and consequences separately.

sections.title: Where the answer can fail
sections.readerQuestion: Why can a polished answer still be wrong?
sections.mechanism: Generation produces a plausible candidate, while weak sources, missing context and unsupported details can survive into fluent output.
sections.distinction: One unsupported detail is enough to be a hallucination; requested creative invention is different.
sections.action: Match consequential claims to exact current evidence outside the answer.

sections.title: Capability labels are not one ladder
sections.readerQuestion: What changes when a system reasons for longer or can take actions?
sections.mechanism: Additional computation and tools can expand capability and consequences without guaranteeing correctness.
sections.distinction: Reasoning, agentic AI and disputed AGI definitions are not one quality scale.
sections.action: Evaluate goal, permissions, checkpoints, logs and the stop path.

sections.title: Put the map to work
sections.mechanism: Different failure locations require different repairs.
sections.distinction: Changing tools cannot repair a missing brief; rewriting a prompt cannot add a missing product capability.
sections.action: Choose the repair that matches the failed layer.
